svg.title: Which road should you take
svg.desc: A decision tree. First question: is startup actually hurting you? If no, stay where you are. If yes, turn on the ahead-of-time cache, then ask whether that was fast enough. If yes, you are done. If no, ask whether the process dies between bursts of traffic — for example a command-line tool, a serverless function, or scale-to-zero containers. If yes, go native and accept the metadata tax. If no, stay on the JVM and look for the latency somewhere else.

text.font-family: Virgil, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', Chalkboard, cursive
Virgil, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', Chalkboard, cursive

svg.text: work down the list — the cheap answer is usually the right one
